name: openbb_crypto_search
description:
Search cryptocurrency symbols by name or ticker through the OpenBB Platform (obb.crypto.search).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): query*; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp; default fmp).
Keyless alternative: cg_search; prices: openbb_crypto_price. Keys: fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {"query": "ethereum"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
